status.not_configured: Supabase keys are missing. The panel needs SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.

ai.image_denied: Could not open the image: no access or the file was deleted. Check that migration 0044 is applied.
ai.no_image: This scan was saved without an image — the upload failed in the mobile app.
ai.private_note: Private conversations — open only for quality review.
ai.subtitle: Usage, scans and model split
ai.tokens_note: There is no token or cost accounting: `ai_messages` lacks the columns. Adding them requires a mobile-app change too (TTZ §6.6, P1).

analytics.export_failed: Export failed ({}). The `admin-export` Edge Function is probably not deployed yet.
analytics.subtitle: Daily metrics and export

audit.empty_hint: An entry appears here after a privileged action
audit.immutable_note: An audit entry cannot be changed or deleted — database triggers enforce that.
audit.subtitle: Admin action log

auth.not_admin_subtitle: This account cannot enter the admin panel.
auth.idle_signed_out: You were signed out after a long period of inactivity. Sign in again.

campaigns.no_push_note: Push is wired up now (`firebase_messaging` + `send-push`). A campaign goes out both as an IN-APP notification and as a device notification; the device one only arrives if the user installed the build with push and signed in — that is when `device_tokens` fills up.
campaigns.send_confirm: {} users will receive this notification: "{}". This cannot be undone.
campaigns.send_failed: Not sent ({}). The `admin-send-campaign` Edge Function is probably not deployed yet.
campaigns.subtitle: Broadcast notifications

common.ask_super_admin: Ask a super admin if you need this.

content.editor_note: This stage covers the list and publication status only. A full editor (three languages, image upload) is separate work.
content.subtitle: Articles, guides and banners

dashboard.no_data: Not enough data for a chart
dashboard.premium_note: The "Premium" metric carries no real business meaning yet: the mobile app never reads the `subscriptions` table and premium is checked nowhere. Do not rely on it for reporting.
dashboard.subtitle: Platform metrics

disease.add_hint: The entry is created as a draft and stays hidden in the mobile app until published.
disease.code_invalid: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and “_” only (3–60 characters).
disease.subtitle: Disease reference and publication status
disease.untranslated: {} entries lack a Russian or English name

errors.cannot_change_own_role: You cannot change your own role.
errors.cannot_delete_founder: The founder's account cannot be deleted.
errors.cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account.
errors.email_exists: An account with this email already exists. Make the existing user staff from the Users section.
errors.founder_is_unique: There is only one founder — this role cannot be assigned.

errors.storage: The file could not be opened.

market.decide_confirm: Listing "{}" will move to "{}". The seller gets a notification.
market.delete_confirm: Listing "{}" will be deleted. Order and chat history is kept.
market.images_no_access: Viewing images requires the moderation permission
market.subtitle: Listing moderation

news.subtitle: Farming news prepared by AI — review queue
news.note: The server prepares news 3 times a day (08:00, 13:00, 19:00). Each item waits 30 minutes: approved goes out at once, rejected never does, and with no decision it is published automatically. Users get one push once the queue is empty.

orders.already_closed: A closed order cannot be cancelled.
orders.cancel_confirm: The order will be cancelled. This cannot be undone.
orders.subtitle: Orders and disputes

settings.mobile_note: NOTE: the mobile app reads this table through the `ai_limits` RPC (0035) — changing the `ai.*` values affects the app immediately. The other keys are used server-side only.
settings.subtitle: System parameters

staff.activate_confirm: {} will regain access to the panel with the previous role.
staff.add_hint: A new account is created and its email is confirmed immediately. To make an existing user staff, use the role button in the Users section.
staff.created_hint: Share the sign-in details with the staff member securely. The password is not shown anywhere else.
staff.deactivate_confirm: {} will lose access to the panel. The role and history are kept; access can be restored at any time.
staff.logins_empty: No sign-in events, or the audit-read permission was not granted.
staff.matrix_note: Read from the database. A permission changed by hand shows up here immediately.
staff.password_hint: New password for {}. Open sessions are not ended — suspend the staff member to cut access immediately.
staff.remove_confirm: {} will stop being staff and cannot enter the panel. Their app account is kept.
staff.subtitle: Staff, roles and the sign-in log

support.empty_hint: Tickets come from the Help section of the mobile app. Until that screen ships in the app, this list stays empty.
support.read_only: The support.write permission is required to reply and change status.
support.resolve_hint: Briefly describe how it was resolved — it helps with similar tickets later.
support.subtitle: User ticket queue and conversations

users.block_confirm: {} will be blocked. They cannot sign in and their listings are hidden.
users.delete_confirm: The account «{}» will be deleted completely, along with its farm, listings and messages. This cannot be undone.
users.force_logout_confirm: All sessions of «{}» will be ended — they will have to sign in again.
users.subtitle: Search by name, email or ID

weather.scope_note: Admins create REGION-level alerts only. Farm-level alerts come from the mobile app itself and admins leave them alone.
weather.subtitle: Region-level alerts

verification.subtitle: Documents submitted by users for the “Verified” badge
verification.note: Check that the name on the document matches the profile and the photo is clear. Once approved, a badge appears next to the user’s name in the market. If you reject, the reason is sent to the user as a push notification and they can apply again.
verification.approve_message: {name} will get the “Verified” badge. A note is optional.
verification.reject_message: The user will see the reason. Be specific, e.g. “Photo is blurry, document number is not visible”.
verification.revoke_message: The “Verified” badge will be removed from {name}.
verification.no_docs: Could not open the document photos — file deleted or no access

disputes.subtitle: Disputes between buyers and sellers over orders
disputes.note: A dispute is opened in the app by one of the order parties. Contact both sides, review the evidence and write a resolution. The resolution text is sent to both parties as a notification and recorded in the audit log — keep it precise and neutral.
disputes.resolve_message: Both parties will see the resolution text. State what was established and what must be done.
disputes.no_photos: Could not open the photos — file deleted or access denied

mfa.enroll_subtitle: Besides your password, signing in will require a code from your phone.
mfa.verify_subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.step_scan: Open Google Authenticator, Authy or a similar app and scan the QR code. Then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.manual_key: If you cannot scan it, enter this key manually:

account.change_password_hint: Enter your current password first. The new password must be at least 8 characters.
account.change_password_hint_code: Confirm it is you with a code from your authenticator app. The new password must be at least 8 characters.

deletions.subtitle: Users who asked to delete their account
deletions.note: Deletion is delayed so the user can change their mind. Nothing is changed here — contact users with open orders in advance.

requests.subtitle: What buyers are looking for and what farmers offer

moderation.subtitle: Reports, auto-blocked messages and posting rate
moderation.read_message: Private messages are confidential. Explain why you need to read them — the reason is written to the audit log.
moderation.read_audited: This access was written to the audit log
moderation.status_message: The note is optional and goes to the audit log.
moderation.auto_note: Messages blocked by AI or the banned-word list. They were never delivered.
moderation.limits_note: Posting rate for a specific user or channel. 0 means no limit; empty means the global rule.
moderation.add_limit_hint: Pick a user, a channel, or both.
moderation.delete_limit_message: The global rule will apply to this user again.
moderation.err_target: Pick a user or a channel.
